cinematic_dialogue:2:1510709002:.text: Decem, why haven't you left yet?

say:5:1510710001:0.text: Decem, the general's already left through the north gate. Aren't you heading out with him?
say:5:1510710001:0.source_cn: 哥哥，统帅大人从城北走了，你不跟上他的队伍吗？

say:6:1510710002:0.text: *Sigh*... You wouldn't get it, Junius. Even I get scared sometimes...
say:6:1510710002:0.source_cn: ……唉，你不懂，哥哥也有害怕的事……

say:7:1510710003:0.text: Are... are you really scared? I heard Beti say his dad went off to war and never came back...
say:7:1510710003:0.source_cn: 你……你是害怕吗？我听说贝迪说，他父亲出征后就再也没回来……

say:8:1510710004:0.text: Junius, listen up. I'm going with the general's elite squad... taking the more dangerous route.
say:8:1510710004:0.source_cn: 朱尼，你仔细听我说，统帅这支队伍……路线比较危险。

say:10:1510710006:0.text: What if... you go and never come back...
say:10:1510710006:0.source_cn: 要是……要是去了就再也回不来的话……

say:11:1510710007:0.text: That won't happen... and you're too young to worry about that.
say:11:1510710007:0.source_cn: 不会的……小小年纪，别担心那么多。

say:12:1510710008:0.text: Junius, I gotta go. You... stay safe, okay?
say:12:1510710008:0.source_cn: 朱尼，哥哥该走了。你……你要好好照顾自己，知道吗？

say:18:1510710010:0.text: That coward's off chasing Perseus' squad.
say:18:1510710010:0.source_cn: 那个懦夫要去追珀尔修斯的队伍。

say:19:1510710011:0.text: <style="highlight">Follow him</style> and we'll learn Perseus' route and goals.

say:21:1510710012:0.text: But we can't just ignore the army's main forces, either...
say:21:1510710012:0.source_cn: 隆尔副将带领的主力军队也不能放着不管……

choice_prompt:23:1510710016.text: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.
choice_prompt:23:1510710016.source_cn: 如果出现紧急情况，记得用传讯石联络。但愿此行我们都能顺利。
choice_prompt:23:1510710016.male: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.
choice_prompt:23:1510710016.female: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.

say:27:1510710014:0.text: Alright. You take Gala and Nazrik with you. And be careful.
say:27:1510710014:0.source_cn: 好，你带着加拉和那非一起去，多加小心。
say:27:1510710014:0.male: Alright. You take Gala and Nazrik with you. And be careful.
say:27:1510710014:0.female: Alright. You take Gala and Nazrik with you. And be careful.

say:28:1510710016:0.text: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.
say:28:1510710016:0.source_cn: 如果出现紧急情况，记得用传讯石联络。但愿此行我们都能顺利。
say:28:1510710016:0.male: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.
say:28:1510710016:0.female: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.

choice:23:0:1.source_cn: 那非可以带我们追踪那个士兵

say:33:1510710015:0.text: Morgan and I will handle things just fine. It's you three that I'm worried about.
say:33:1510710015:0.source_cn: 交给我和摩根吧，你们也多加小心。
say:33:1510710015:0.male: Morgan and I will handle things just fine. It's you three that I'm worried about.
say:33:1510710015:0.female: Morgan and I will handle things just fine. It's you three that I'm worried about.

choice:23:1:2.text: And you deal with the main forces.
choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 大部队那边交给你们了
choice:23:1:2.male: And you deal with the main forces.
choice:23:1:2.female: And you deal with the main forces.

narration:34:15010713:0.text: You come across a lone soldier who seems to have fallen behind Perseus' army out of fear.
narration:34:15010713:0.source_cn: 你们发现一个落单的呼临士兵，似乎因为害怕没跟上珀尔修斯...
